name: chuno-backend
description: Microservicios de Banca por Internet - STARTUP CHUNO

scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v db && docker compose up -d --wait db
scripts.db:migrate: npm run build --workspace=@chuno/shared && npm run migration:run --workspaces --if-present
scripts.db:seed: npm run seed:dev --workspace=ms-clientes --if-present && npm run seed:dev --workspace=ms-cuentas --if-present && npm run seed:dev --workspace=ms-pagos --if-present && npm run seed:dev --workspace=ms-transferencias --if-present && npm run seed:dev --workspace=ms-prestamos --if-present
